observed_behavior: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.3 applies where a web page can be navigated sequentially and those navigation sequences affect meaning or operation; focusable components must then receive focus in an order preserving meaning and operability.
context: WCAG 2.2 W3C Recommendation, 12 December 2024; exact criterion 2.4.3 Focus Order; focused W07 B1 K3 normative extraction. Level A; requirement and associated W3C notes/conditions only.
limitations: Conditionally applies to sequential keyboard navigation affecting meaning or operation; not a mandate that every visual order matches every DOM order.
Does not establish a universal initial focus destination for dialogs, exact order of nested overlays, or focus-return algorithm.
No keyboard sequence, accessibility-tree, or application interaction was observed.
